raw_blocks: Federated Hermes is a leading global, active asset manager, focused on meeting the diverse and evolving needs of today’s investors. For 70 years, our world-class investment platform has provided active investment expertise across the spectrum, in both public and private markets. Our solutions span equity, fixed income, liquidity, private markets and responsible investments.

Through a relentless commitment to doing business the right way by seeking better outcomes for every client, Federated Hermes has established a position as one of the leaders in the asset management industry. We are differentiated by our deep market experience, independent-thinking investment teams, integrated proprietary research, dynamic data sources and our engagement and stewardship capabilities.

Federated Hermes aims to deliver strong performance consistent with our clients’ needs and expectations by setting a standard for active investment management. Our rigorous approach to vetting investment opportunities, careful attention to prudently allocating risks and dedication to building insightful teams have been key to our investing for decades.

For more than 50 years, Federated Hermes has delivered active fixed-income strategies designed to meet a range of investor needs. Whether the goal is total return, income generation or capital preservation, we have a strategy that’s been vetted to fit the bill.
Wide range of global capabilities

Federated Hermes offers investment capabilities designed to deliver attractive financial outcomes across a broad array of asset classes. Our investment solutions span a range of risk and return profiles, helping us to target investors' specific financial needs.
Growth, dividend, small cap, quantitative and global equity strategies drawing on our decades of experience in the equity markets.
Active fixed-income strategies across the spectrum (yield curve, quality and regions) designed for a variety of goals such as total return, income generation and capital preservation.
Liquidity management is a core business of Federated Hermes and we use our decades of experience to ruthlessly vet investments in our aim to provide sound liquidity management.
Private equity, private debt, infrastructure and real estate solutions for institutional investors around the world.

We pursue long-term, risk-adjusted returns guided by fiduciary duty and client investment objectives. Responsible investing reflects our belief that financial connectivity and prudent stewardship are key to helping clients meet investment goals.
Our commitment to doing business the right way
Our company-wide commitment to put clients first, to act responsibly and to be transparent.
Federated Hermes is committed to serving our clients and shareholders as diligent and capable fiduciaries.

An investment in money market funds is neither insured nor guaranteed by the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation or any other government agency. It is possible to lose money by investing in these funds.
Bond prices are sensitive to changes in interest rates and a rise in interest rates can cause a decline in their prices.
Investing in equities is speculative and involves substantial risk.
Private investments are not suitable for all investors, are generally illiquid, and have the potential for significant losses.
Investments are subject to risk and fluctuate in value.

Since 1955, our goal has been to help you reach yours. With deep experience across a wide range of asset classes, Federated Hermes provides access to fixed income, liquidity, equity, private markets and responsible investing solutions.

Federated Hermes has thrived as a leading global, active investment manager. Our goal is to deliver competitive performance consistent with our clients’ needs and expectations by setting a high standard for active investment management. Our rigorous approach to vetting investment opportunities and careful attention to prudently allocating risk have been key aspects of our approach for decades.
We offer a wide range of retail and institutional liquidity options, spanning corporate, government and municipal offerings.
We invest across the global government, corporate, high-yield and municipal markets, seeking attractive total returns for our investors.
We offer our clients growth, dividend, small cap, quantitative and global equity strategies drawing on our decades of experience in the equity markets.
We offer institutional investors access to private equity, private credit, real estate and infrastructure.

We pursue long-term, risk-adjusted returns guided by fiduciary duty and client investment objectives. Responsible investing reflects our belief that financial connectivity and prudent stewardship are key to helping clients meet investment goals.

Our nearly 400 investment professionals are dedicated to navigating the complexities of the equity, fixed income and liquidity markets around the world. Through each team’s disciplined approach, innovative strategies, and rigorously vetted security selection process, we build our clients solutions to help them achieve their long-term objectives.
President and chief executive officer, Federated Advisory Companies
